category_title: Young child with severe autism engaging in physical aggression
minimal_context: Lauren is in her special education classroom at the beginning of snack time, waiting while her preferred food item is placed in sight but out of reach.
dialogue:
TUTOR: It is time for snack. I am putting your food up here on the counter where you can see it, but we have to wait.

STUDENT: (Reaches toward the counter) Snack.

TUTOR: We are just waiting right now.

STUDENT: (Grabs the teacher's clothing) Eat.

TUTOR: Let go, please. You need to stand there and wait.

STUDENT: (Screams loudly, then starts pushing and kicking the teacher)

options.A: Request clarification from the student, asking for explanations and elaborations about the food item.
options.B: Provide access to the preferred food item for an increased duration of one minute.
options.C: Thank the student for communicating and offer a choice of an alternative food item.
options.D: Follow through with physical guidance to ensure the student complies with the direction to wait.
